title: IPoUGRSFrame
description: Logical representation of an IPoUGRS-encoded wire frame for inspection + debugging. Used by GET /api/ipougrs/recent if exposed; primarily a documentation contract for the codec implementation.

magic.description: 0x49 = 'I' (IPoUGRS magic byte, first byte of every encoded frame)

ip_packet_hex.description: Decoded IPv4 packet bytes, hex-encoded for inspection (NOT the wire form)

encoded_size_bytes.description: Total wire-frame size including magic + version

compression.description: Encoding strategy used for the inner packet
